$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside #target (the badge) and how to read it.

root.$why: root is the badge itself (#target). It hugs its label, whose width follows glyph rasterisation; the manifest's size check (±2 px) still covers it.

Frame.$why: The label frame hugs its text, whose width follows glyph rasterisation.

Image.$why: The picture's 0.5 px stroke is an ::after overlay (an inset shadow on an is drawn under the picture).
